text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I managed to take 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"The moment you cross the finish line in 
first, basked in roaring cheers... it 
fills you with an indescribable sense of 
fulfillment."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to your support, Trainer, 
that I'm able to feel this way now. Thank 
you so very much.
choice_data_list:
You were shining at your absolute 
brightest!

Don't let your guard down—let's aim for 
victory again next time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. I take pride in knowing we gave a 
run that will remain in the hearts of 
everyone who watched the race."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I will continue to 
devote myself to running races that will 
remain in your memories, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I would love to experience that 
sensation again— the feeling of crossing 
the finish line first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to your continued guidance 
and support."
